In the second week, agomelatine slightly improves sleep continuity (increased total sleep time and sleep efficiency) and escitalopram worsens it [25].

Moreover, treatment with agomelatine is not related to the suppression of REM sleep: it restores cyclical sleep profile, may increase the amount of SWS, and most importantly leads to the improvement of daytime alertness [26].

In humans, oral administration of caffeine prior to nocturnal sleep increases sleep latency and reduces sleep efficiency.
Adenosine, however, is relevant for sleep medicine, as insomnia can be caused by consumption of caffeine or by the respiratory stimulant theophylline.
First generation H1 receptor antagonists, such as diphenhydramine, cause drowsiness (sedation) and impaired performance in humans 95 and rats.

96 Newer antagonists that are relatively selective for the H1 histamine receptor, such as the potent antagonist doxepin, improve subjective and objective measures of sleep in insomnia patients without causing sedation or psychomotor impairments the next day.
However, due to the lack of methodologically sound randomized clinical trials in insomnia, only one of them, doxepin, is approved by FDA for the treatment of sleep maintenance insomnia.
